name: Bahamas

findings.summary: Government signed a US$1.9m phased contract with US-based ShotSpotter in January 2019 for gunshot-detection sensors and expanded police CCTV; by 2023 ShotSpotter sensors fed the RBPF Real-Time Crime Center in Nassau.
findings.analyst_inference: Tier 5 because the 2023 trade article describes ShotSpotter sensors operating within the crime centre; an unopened Eyewitness News headline says the technology is being upgraded, suggesting it is still in use, but still_current left null. Scale subnational (New Providence/Nassau). The 2019 article does not say whether the US$1.9m covers the 508 additional cameras or only ShotSpotter.

findings.summary: The RBPF Real-Time Crime Center in Nassau, operating since February 2021, runs Milestone XProtect video management over 500+ Axis cameras, with BriefCam facial recognition and licence-plate analytics, Rasilient servers and Cisco fibre networking.
findings.analyst_inference: Pole third is analyst inference: the article gives no vendor nationalities; Milestone (Denmark), Axis (Sweden) and BriefCam (Israel-founded) are understood to be Canon (Japan) group companies. Cisco fibre components (US) and Rasilient servers (US) are minor parts not separately coded. Single opened trade source, possibly vendor-supplied case study; no PRC vendor named.

findings.local_actor: Office of the Prime Minister, Bahamas; Bahamas Technological Services Ltd. (BTSL)
findings.summary: The Prime Minister met an International Data Center Authority delegation, with Aton Path, the US-led Accessible Energy Bank and local partner BTSL, as a sovereign digital-hub initiative was signed; no terms, sites or values disclosed.

sources.publisher: Office of the Prime Minister, The Bahamas

findings.analyst_inference: Pole null: no facility owner-operator is identified; IDCA appears to be an advisory/standards body (an unopened Intellinews headline calls it US-based). Tier 1 because the instrument is an undefined 'initiative' with no disclosed binding terms. Meeting date inferred from 'yesterday' in the 29 July release.
